Complemented range and min-max dimension arguments give all four s-number lower bounds; truncating finite-row spectral modes above t>max(q_n,gamma) provides rank <n with error ≤t, proving exact equality. Polar factors x=u|a|^1/2,y=|a|^1/2 are in A and theta_{x,y}=L_a. A nonzero infinite block row is an infinite-dimensional isomorphic subspace defeating strict singular perturbations; finite-mode truncations give matching distances. q_n→0 follows from a_j→0. The cubic multiplicity example follows from sum_{j≤J}j²~J³/3. These are analytic arguments for arbitrary countably many blocks, not extrapolated from CHECK.py.
